Name: Decay
Author: legiorange
Description:
[b]Decay [/b]transforms your farm’s economy by introducing a realistic, data-driven freshness system for perishable goods. This mod is designed for players seeking a deeper level of inventory management and a meaningful way to handle spoiled harvests.

🟢 Dynamic Decay & Environmental LogicThe core of the mod is a sophisticated decay engine that evaluates every item based on its category and the environment it occupies:
[list]
[*][b]Shelf-Life by Category[/b]: Each food group has a unique base durability. For example, fish and meat are highly perishable (2 days), while hardy vegetables (4 days) .
[*][b]Refrigeration[/b]: Storing items in a Fridge or Mini-Fridge,effectively doubling their shelf life.
[*][b]Seasonal Weather[/b]: The system tracks the game’s calendar. Decay speed increases during the heat of [b]Summer[/b], while items kept outdoors during [b]Winter[/b] benefit from a [b]0.25x multiplier[/b].
[/list]
♻️ Waste-to-Treasure: RecyclingInstead of simply disappearing, spoiled items turn into [b]Rotten Plants[/b]. This mod integrates with the [b]Recycling Machine[/b] to provide a late-game utility for waste:
[list]
[*][b]Deluxe Speed-Gro Extraction[/b]: By placing [b]50 Rotten Plants[/b] into a Recycling Machine, you can extract [b]1 Deluxe Speed-Gro[/b].
[*][b]Balanced Progression[/b]: This 50:1 ratio ensures that while spoiled crops are a loss, they can eventually be recycled into a powerful tool to accelerate your next harvest
[/list]
🖥️ User Interface & LocalizationThe mod provides clear visual feedback without cluttering the screen:
[list]
[*][b]Freshness Bar[/b]: When holding a perishable item, a dynamic bar appears at the bottom of the screen. The bar shifts from [b]Lime Green to Red[/b] as the item approaches its expiration.
[*][b]Hover Details[/b]: Hovering over the bar reveals the exact freshness percentage via the [b]i18n translation system[/b].
[*][b]Full Localization[/b]: Supports both [b]English[/b] and [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b] out of the box, with UTF-8 encoding to ensure no display errors.
[/list]
* You can safely remove this mod.
